info.title: Relay API
info.summary: Staff and public published-content API for the Relay podcast network platform.
info.description:
OpenAPI v0 covers the **Phase 1** surface (P0-04): catalog CRUD, resumable uploads, processing
status, transcripts, notes and chapters, approvals and rights, scheduling and publishing, feed
preview, jobs, the audit-events read API, full export, and the public published-content API.
Phase 2–3 entities are modelled in `model/erd.md` but have no endpoints yet.

## Conventions

- **Errors** are `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457). `type` is a URI under
  `https://relay.dev/problems/`, and `code` is a stable machine-readable string.
  Disallowed state transitions return `409` with type `…/problems/invalid-transition`
  (`model/state-machines.md`).
- **Pagination** is cursor-based. List operations take `cursor` and `limit`, and return
  `{items, nextCursor}`. `nextCursor` is `null` on the last page. Cursors are opaque.
- **Idempotency.** Every mutating operation (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`) requires an
  `Idempotency-Key` header. A replay with the same key and body returns the original response.
  The same key with a different body returns `409` with type
  `…/problems/idempotency-key-reused`. Keys are kept for 24 hours.
- **Optimistic concurrency.** Mutable resources return an `ETag`. `PATCH`, `PUT`, and `DELETE` on
  them require `If-Match` (`428` if missing, `412` if stale).
- **Partial updates** use JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396): an absent field is unchanged, and `null`
  clears a nullable field.
- **Identifiers** are lowercase UUIDs, except the episode `guid`, which is an opaque string
  (ADR 0006). Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC with `Z`. Durations are integer milliseconds and sizes
  are integer bytes.
- **Authorization.** Staff operations use OIDC bearer tokens from the `relay-staff` realm.
  Authorization lives in the API (decision A9). Each operation declares the minimum actor in
  `x-relay-authz` (`model/state-machines.md`, "Actors"): `staff` (any signed-in staff user),
  `viewer+`, `producer+`, `editor+` (grants on the operation's show), or `admin`
  (`networkAdmin`). Operations under `/public` are anonymous and never vary by credentials.
- **Caching.** Public responses are cacheable and carry no personal data. Staff responses are
  `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. The two never share cache entries.

tags.name: network
tags.description: The single network (tenant) and its defaults.

tags.name: access
tags.description: Staff users and show-scoped role grants (P1-02).

tags.name: seasons
tags.description: Optional grouping of episodes inside a show.

tags.name: episodes
tags.description: Episode identity, publication status, readiness, scheduling, and publishing. The four state dimensions are described in `model/state-machines.md`.

tags.name: revisions
tags.description: Editable episode content and its review workflow (state machine §2).

tags.name: notes
tags.description: Show-notes rendering (TipTap JSON to sanitized HTML and Markdown, decision A15).

tags.name: rights
tags.description: Rights and licence clearance that gates readiness.

tags.name: approvals
tags.description: The immutable record of editorial decisions.

tags.name: media
tags.description: Media asset versions and their processing state (state machine §3). Uploads use the [tus 1.0 protocol](https://tus.io/protocols/resumable-upload). This API creates an upload session and returns its tus URL. The tus requests themselves (`HEAD`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` on the upload URL) are served by `tusd` inside relay-api, and are not part of this document.

tags.name: transcripts
tags.description: Transcript revisions (state machine §4). Machine output is always a draft.

tags.name: jobs
tags.description: Durable background work (River dispatch, Argo execution).

tags.name: publishing
tags.description: Release manifests, delivery receipts, and per-output delivery state.

tags.name: exports
tags.description: Full, versioned export (`schemas/export-index.schema.json` and `schemas/export-record.schema.json`). Secrets are never exported.

tags.name: public
tags.description: Anonymous published-content API for relay-site. Everything is built from release manifests, so it never shows unreleased content.

get.description: Returns every blocking reason, not only the first. Without `revisionId`, the candidate is the episode's open revision.

post.description: Creates the immutable release manifest and enqueues the output jobs in one transaction. The episode moves to `publishing`, and to `published` once the owned outputs are verified (P6). Republishing an `unpublished` episode needs `admin`.

post.description: The server chooses the kind: `initial` for an unreleased episode, `correction` once a manifest exists. A correction copies the released revision. Fails with `409` if the episode already has an open revision.

patch.description: Allowed only in `draft` and `correction_draft`. A revision is frozen once submitted (R3), so edits after that return `409`.

post.description: Creates a `MediaAsset` in `uploading` and returns its tus upload URL. Pass `lineageId` to upload a replacement version of an existing asset. staffOidc.description: Bearer access tokens from the Keycloak `relay-staff` realm (decision A9). The admin app uses the authorization code flow with PKCE, and the realm requires TOTP.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A client-generated key, unique per intended operation (a UUIDv4 is recommended). Required on every mutating operation. A replay with the same key and body returns the original response.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The `ETag` from the last read. Required on writes to mutable resources.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The opaque `nextCursor` from the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

ETag.description: The entity tag of the returned representation.

Location.description: The URL of the created or target resource.

PublicCacheControl.description: Public responses are cacheable, for example `public, max-age=60, stale-if-error=86400`, and never vary by credentials.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or fails validation. `errors` lists each field.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the role this operation needs (`x-relay-authz`).

NotFound.description: No such resource, or the caller may not know it exists. Resources on shows the caller has no grant on return `404`, not `403`.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the resource's state: an invalid transition, a blocked readiness check (`blockingReasons`), a uniqueness violation, or a reused idempotency key.

Gone.description: The resource was published and has been withdrawn.

PreconditionFailed.description: `If-Match` does not match the current `ETag`. Re-read and retry.

ContentTooLarge.description: The declared size exceeds the show's limit.

ReleaseManifest.title: Release manifest
ReleaseManifest.description: The immutable record of one episode release: exactly which approved inputs, asset versions, and public metadata were published. It never contains feed hashes or delivery results; those live in delivery receipts that reference this manifest (model/erd.md, ADR 0006). The manifest's own SHA-256 is computed over its RFC 8785 canonical JSON and stored alongside it, not inside it.

schemaVersion.description: Major.minor version of this schema. Minor versions only add optional fields.

sequence.description: 1 for the first release of the episode, then +1 for each later manifest.

kind.description: `release` for the first publish; `correction` for every later manifest, including a republish.

previousManifestId.description: The manifest this one replaces. Null only for the first release.

slug.description: The slug at release time. Informational only; slugs are mutable.

guid.description: The permanent episode GUID. An opaque string: a UUIDv4 for native episodes, or the imported value byte for byte (ADR 0006). Identical in every manifest of the episode.

accessClass.description: Who may receive this release (decision A10): anonymous listeners, signed-in free accounts, or paid entitlements.

edition.description: Which edition of the episode this manifest releases. Each edition has its own manifests.

requiredEntitlement.description: The entitlement feature a paid release requires.

originalPublishedAt.description: The first release's publication time. Identical in every manifest of the episode; it is the feed pubDate forever.

effectiveAt.description: When this manifest became the current release. Equals originalPublishedAt for sequence 1.

scheduleGeneration.description: The episode's schedule generation when this manifest was created. A scheduled job whose generation differs never produces a manifest.

enclosure.description: The explicitly selected enclosure. The URL and exact length are pinned; a correction that keeps the same asset version keeps the same URL (ADR 0006).

assets.description: Every media asset version this release makes public, including the enclosure. Each entry is one immutable version.

transcript.description: The approved transcript revision, or null if the release has no transcript.

assetIds.description: The rendered transcript and caption files. Each must also appear in `assets`.

chapters.description: The approved chapter set, or null.

assetId.description: The rendered podcast:chapters JSON file. It must also appear in `assets`.

rights.description: The cleared rights records this release relied on, pinned for export and takedown decisions.

license.description: An SPDX or Creative Commons identifier (for example CC-BY-4.0), or `custom`.

approvals.description: Every approval this release depends on. Must include an approval of the episode revision.

approverId.description: The approving StaffUser. Only the ID is pinned, so no personal data is copied into the manifest.

adMarkers.description: Phase 3: ad slots pinned to exact rendition versions. Omit when there are none.

createdBy.description: Who triggered the release: a staff user (publish now) or the scheduler (a fired schedule).

DeliveryReceipt.title: Delivery receipt
DeliveryReceipt.description: The immutable record of one attempt to deliver a release manifest to one output: a feed snapshot, the website, the media edge, or an external destination. Receipts reference the manifest; the manifest never references receipts. Delivery state is derived from the receipts (model/state-machines.md §5).

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the manifest's RFC 8785 canonical JSON, so a receipt proves which exact manifest it delivered.

destinationKey.description: The destination's key, as data (for example `youtube`). Never a type.

result.description: Owned outputs end in `delivered` or `failed`. Destinations use `submitted`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `manual_required`, or `withdrawn`.

idempotencyKey.description: `{output}:{manifestId}` for owned outputs, `{publicationTargetId}:{manifestId}` for destinations. Retries reuse it.

feedSnapshot.description: Required for a delivered feed snapshot: the object that was written and verified.

edge.description: Required for a delivered media_edge output: the HEAD and byte-range checks of the enclosure URL.

external.description: What the destination returned. Values are opaque data.

confirmedBy.description: For a manual confirmation: the staff user who recorded it.

error.description: Required when result is `failed`. A problem+json-shaped summary, redacted of tokens and signed URLs.

code.description: A stable machine-readable code, for example `invalid_transition`.

blockingReasons.description: Every failing readiness check, when publishing or scheduling is blocked.

currentState.description: For `invalid-transition`, the state the resource is in.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the offending field in the request body.

retiredVersionRetentionDays.description: How long retired media versions stay served (ADR 0006 V8). Never below 30.

slug.description: Mutable, and used only in site URLs. Never an identifier.

feedUrl.description: The canonical public feed URL, served from feed snapshots.

newFeedUrl.description: Set only while a feed migration's redirect period runs (P1-16).

requireSeparateApprover.description: When true (the default), an approver must not be the submitter.

transcriptionAutoStart.description: Start self-hosted transcription automatically when a master is ready (T1).

subjectId.description: The record that failed the check, when there is one.

revisionId.description: The candidate revision that was checked, or null if there is none.

Episode.description: The permanent identity of one episode and its state dimensions. Content lives in revisions.

guid.description: The permanent episode GUID. Read-only. A lowercase UUIDv4 for native episodes, or the imported value byte for byte (ADR 0006).

corrected.description: True when the current manifest is a correction.

openRevisionId.description: The revision being edited or reviewed, if any. At most one per episode.

releasedRevisionId.description: The revision pinned by the current manifest.

originalPublishedAt.description: Set by the first release and never changed. The feed `pubDate` forever.

pendingSchedule.description: The pending schedule, if any. A published episode can have one for a correction.

title.description: The title of the open revision, or of the released one when nothing is open.

revisionId.description: The approved revision to release. It must be the episode's open revision.

NotesDoc.description: TipTap/ProseMirror JSON, the source of truth for show notes (decision A15). Node types outside the allow-list are rejected on render.

NotesNode.description: A ProseMirror node. Its shape depends on `type`.

enclosureAssetId.description: The explicitly selected enclosure version (ADR 0006 V5). There is no "latest".

basedOnRevisionId.description: Copy content from this revision. Defaults to the released revision, if any.

html.description: Sanitized HTML, safe for feeds and the site.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of `html` as UTF-8, as pinned in the manifest (`notesSha256`).

warnings.description: Content the sanitizer removed or changed.

mediaAssetId.description: Set for rights that apply to one asset version only.

license.description: An SPDX or Creative Commons identifier (for example `CC-BY-4.0`), or `custom`.

hasDocument.description: Whether a private rights document is attached. It is never exposed publicly.

AssetRole.description: What a file is for. Separate from its format.

AssetFormat.description: How a file is encoded. Separate from its role.

episodeId.description: Null for show or person artwork.

lineageId.description: Shared by every version of one logical asset.

format.description: Null until the probe identifies an uploaded file.

fileName.description: Chosen when the version is created, and never changed (ADR 0006 V3).

sha256.description: Computed by the server over the stored object. Null until the upload completes.

sourceAssetId.description: The version this file was derived from (ADR 0006 V11).

problem.description: Why the asset was rejected or failed, when it was.

publicUrl.description: The permanent versioned URL `https://{media-host}/a/{assetId}/{fileName}`, assigned when a release first uses the version. Masters never get one.

role.description: Uploads create masters and artwork. Other roles are derived by the pipeline.

lineageId.description: Upload a new version of this lineage. Omit it to start a new lineage.

bytes.description: The declared size. tus rejects any other length.

assetId.description: The new version, in `uploading`. Null for rights documents, which are not assets.

uploadUrl.description: The tus upload URL. Send `PATCH` requests with `Upload-Offset` and the staff bearer token. Resume with `HEAD`.

expiresAt.description: After this, an incomplete upload is abandoned (M3).

TranscriptSource.description: How the transcript was made. Engine names are data, never types.

sourceAssetId.description: The exact media version that was transcribed.

engine.description: The adapter name and model, as data (for example `faster-whisper/small`).

jobId.description: The processing job for machine transcripts.

source.description: Machine providers only. Manual transcripts use the manual upload operation.

language.description: Omit it to let the engine detect the language.

content.description: The file's contents as UTF-8 text, at most 5 MB.

timedAgainstAssetId.description: The exact media version these timestamps are valid for.

ProcessingJob.description: The durable record of one unit of background work. Its ID is the idempotency key.

externalRef.description: The Argo workflow name, when the job runs there.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the body's RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

state.description: Delivery of the current manifest to this output.

publishedHere.description: True when the feed snapshot and website are delivered for the current manifest.

key.description: The destination's key, as data (for example `rss_directory`). Never a type.

capabilitiesVerifiedAt.description: When the capabilities were last checked against the destination's documentation.

replacesMedia.description: Whether a corrected enclosure replaces the old media there (D10 versus D11).

lastConfirmedManifestId.description: "Confirmed available there" means `state: confirmed` and this equals the episode's current manifest.

manifestIds.description: Every release manifest rendered into this snapshot.

AuditEvent.description: An append-only record of a state-changing command.

action.description: A dotted action name, for example `episode.revision.approved`.

diff.description: A redacted before/after of the changed fields.

includeMedia.description: Whether media bytes are copied into the archive, not only inventoried.

url.description: The permanent versioned media URL (ADR 0006 V3).

PublicEpisode.description: Built only from the current release manifest's pinned metadata, never from draft or mutable catalog rows.

publishedAt.description: The original publication time. Corrections never change it.

updatedAt.description: When the current manifest took effect.

transcriptUrl.description: The approved `podcast_json` transcript file, if the release has one.

chaptersUrl.description: The approved `podcast:chapters` JSON file, if the release has one.

source.description: Shown to listeners so machine transcripts are labelled.

ReleaseManifestTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC with a Z suffix.

role.description: What the file is for. Masters are never released, so `master` is not allowed here.

format.description: How the file is encoded. Separate from role, so one schema covers audio, video, and premium editions.

sourceAssetId.description: The master (or other source) version this file was derived from.

ReleaseManifestMetadata.description: The public metadata pinned at release time, enough to render the feed item and page without reading mutable catalog rows.

notesHtml.description: Show notes rendered from TipTap JSON and sanitized at release time (A15).

link.description: The episode page URL on the network site.

imageAssetId.description: Episode artwork; must also appear in `assets`. Omit to use show artwork.

show.description: The show-level metadata this release was published under.

DeliveryReceiptChecks.description: Named verification checks and whether each passed, for example guidPreserved, enclosureLengthMatches.
